parts.text: Build me an app that matches cat and dog breeds by whether they look alike. Include photos
I'll build you a "Cat & Dog Lookalike Matcher" app. Let me start by scaffolding it.
Let me build the full app. I'll design curated cat-dog lookalike pairs with reasoning, and use image sources that work within CSP. Let me first check what the Build App skill recommends for images.

For images, the sandbox blocks external network access except the CDN allowlist. So I can't hotlink random cat/dog photos. I'll use inline SVG illustrations of each breed — self-contained, no network needed, and they'll render reliably. Let me build the app with curated lookalike pairs and distinctive SVG portraits.

Done. Your app is ready: [Cat & Dog Lookalike Matcher](/a/22b717fc-4d01-4649-b1e7-74ee31173759)

It shows 8 curated cat↔dog lookalike pairs side by side — each with a match score, a heart, and a one-liner explaining *why* they look alike (e.g. Persian ↔ Chow Chow, Russian Blue ↔ Weimaraner, Sphynx ↔ Chinese Crested). Hit **🔀 Shuffle** to reorder them.

One honest caveat about the "include photos" part: the app sandbox blocks all external network access (no network channel, only a fixed CDN allowlist), so I *can't* hotlink real breed photos from the web — they'd just fail to load. Instead each breed is drawn as a self-contained SVG portrait tuned to its coat color, ear shape, and eye color, so the visuals render reliably every time with zero network dependency.

If you'd rather have actual photographs, that's doable but only if there's an MCP tool assigned that can serve image data (e.g. one that returns image bytes/data URLs) — the app can display those. Want me to hunt for one and wire it in? Otherwise the illustrated version stands on its own.

enhancement.description: Curated cat-and-dog breed lookalike pairs shown side by side with match scores and why-they-match notes, in self-contained SVG portraits.
enhancement.prompt: Build me an app that pairs cat breeds with the dog breeds they look most alike, showing each pair side by side with a match score and a short line explaining why they resemble each other, plus a shuffle button to reorder them, using a curated set of lookalike pairs with a portrait for each breed.
enhancement.response:
Your Cat & Dog Lookalike Matcher is built — a side-by-side gallery pairing cat and dog breeds that resemble each other.

- Shows 8 curated cat↔dog lookalike pairs, each displayed side by side with a match score and a heart
- Gives a one-line reason for every match explaining why they look alike — Persian ↔ Chow Chow, Russian Blue ↔ Weimaraner, Sphynx ↔ Chinese Crested, and more
- Draws each breed as a self-contained SVG portrait tuned to its coat color, ear shape, and eye color, so every visual renders instantly
- A 🔀 Shuffle button reorders the pairs whenever you want a fresh view

Just open it and scroll through the pairs; tap Shuffle to mix them up.

One honest note on the "include photos" part: the app sandbox blocks external network access except a fixed CDN allowlist, so I couldn't hotlink real breed photos — they'd fail to load. That's why each breed is a hand-tuned SVG instead. If you'd rather have actual photographs, I can do that only if there's an MCP tool assigned that serves image data (bytes or data URLs) — say the word and I'll hunt one down and wire it in.
